quizzes.question: Which is the best Kaizen problem statement?
options: “We need a robot arm on the monitor line”
“Cycle time is 38 s vs a 35 s TAKT, with 2 flips per unit; reach 35 s in 4 weeks”
quizzes.explanation: A good statement has the measured gap, the observed loss and a target with a deadline, without naming a solution or blaming people.

quizzes.question: A trial cuts cycle time by 4 seconds, but operators report shoulder strain. What now?
options: Treat it as not yet successful: adapt the method and re-test
Rotate operators every hour and keep it
quizzes.explanation: The balanced rule: a Kaizen succeeds only if safety, quality and people don't suffer. Strain means the method needs changing before it becomes the standard.
